info.title: Managing CPU shielding with &systemd;, taskset and chrt

abstract.para: Isolate real-time workloads on dedicated logical CPUs using &systemd; resource control, taskset and chrt.

procedure.title: Configuring CPU isolation for real-time workloads
procedure.para: To restrict general processes to CPUs 0 to 2 and dedicate CPU 3 to a critical task, perform the following steps:

step.para: Restrict the system slices to CPUs 0-2. The setting is persistent. To apply it only until the next reboot, add the --runtime option.
step.screen: &prompt.sudo;systemctl set-property system.slice AllowedCPUs=0-2 &prompt.sudo;systemctl set-property user.slice AllowedCPUs=0-2 &prompt.sudo;systemctl set-property init.scope AllowedCPUs=0-2
